digest.component_or_area: BindingStore persistence and rotation state management
propositions: Remove inline last_get_pass field from bindings.json after successful new-writer save, leaving no legacy field remnants in persisted state
BindingStore.save() must persist sidecar rotation state atomically before scrubbing and writing bindings to enforce chronological max promotion and crash-safe boundaries
A failed sidecar write must allow primary binding save to succeed with latest inline floor intact; crash after sidecar replace must not lose maximum rotation state
Legacy and new writer sequences must converge by promoting any later legacy inline stamp into get_rotation.json before scrub, preserving maximum across mixed-version deployments
Host probe and reconciler binaries must be explicitly refreshed to A2-1-or-newer descendant builds with no older process remaining to satisfy compatibility gate
